patterns.note: The page features a two-tone layout, starting with an airy, minimalist light hero section that transitions dramatically into a dense, dark footer section upon scroll.
Headings use a large, bold sans-serif font for impact, contrasted with smaller, legible sans-serif for body text and uppercase labels for navigation and secondary information.

A high-contrast color scheme is employed, shifting from a soft, light background in the hero to a deep, warm dark background in the footer, with a vibrant orange serving as the primary accent and call-to-action color.

Upon scrolling, the initial light hero content scrolls up and out of view, while a large, orange 'daylight' logo animates in from the top, growing significantly in size and changing color as a dark, warm gradient background simultaneously reveals from the bottom, transforming the page's entire visual mood.

The homepage is structured as a single, highly impactful hero section that directly transforms into a comprehensive footer, with no intermediate content sections visible in the scroll sequence, creating a very concise user journey.

technique_notes: The initial hero section uses a full-bleed light background with a large, centered headline and a subtle, monochromatic illustration. A video hero is presented as a thumbnail with a play button.

A scroll-triggered animation system, likely using canvas or a similar technique, orchestrates a dramatic page transformation: the light hero content scrolls away, while a new dark, warm-toned section with an oversized, animating brand logo and full footer content reveals. The background itself transitions from light to a dark gradient.
Call-to-action buttons feature a solid, vibrant orange fill with subtle rounded corners and white text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif hero heading (~4-5x body) with smaller, regular weight sans-serif for body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle: buttons, video thumbnail, and newsletter popup have gently rounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in the hero section, creating a sense of calm and focus; transitions to a balanced density in the dark footer section.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the dramatic, scroll-triggered page transformation from a minimalist, light-themed hero to a bold, dark footer, accompanied by an oversized, animating brand logo reveal. This creates a strong emotional impact and a memorable brand experience, moving beyond typical sticky navs or simple fade-ins.
